content_sections.heading: How Will Rajanna Sircilla District Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: 90 marks will be allotted based on the marks obtained in qualifying examination for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Dieticians, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional. 10 marks will be awarded for the age (Weightage for age will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate 0.5 mark will be awarded for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks). Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained with above criteria and displayed on website. Selection list will be prepared from the finalized merit list duly following the rule of reservation and Presidential Order. Total Marks are 100 of which 90 marks will be allotted basing on the marks obtained in qualifying examination. 10 marks will be awarded for the age.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination Intermediate or 10+2 examination Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and Medical Officer Posts) Registration Certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study Certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class and in case of Private Study Residency Certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Rajanna Sircilla District Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download application forms along with the instructions from the official website of Rajanna Sircilla District. Fill in application forms and submit in person or through registered post to the O/o. the District Medical & Health Office, IDOC Rajanna Sircilla District. Enclose self-attested copies of required certificates including SSC, intermediate, qualifying examination pass certificate, marks memos, registration certificates, caste certificate, study certificate, and PH certificate if applicable. Attach 1 photograph duly pasted on the application form and an acknowledgment card. Make sure it reaches by 29 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: District Selection Committee is not responsible for the postal delays. For Psychosocial Counselor, a panel of eligible candidates may be empanelled. The empanelled candidates shall be engaged on a call basis, as and when their services are required.
